description.sub_ename: RESEARCH ON POETS OF THE TANG DYNASTY
description.describe_ch: 詩歌作品利用高度凝鍊的語言，按照一定的格律要求，表達作者心靈感受。一首首打動人心、流傳千年的詩作，都是作者透過作品表現了他的情感與態度，進而讓讀者在作品中感受到。影響詩人創作的原因很多，除了所處的時代環境之外，最重要的還是詩人本身的個性及其生活際遇。本課程希望讓學生透過細緻觀察唐代詩人的經歷，細微鑑賞詩作，不要僅將焦點擺在時代環境的共相，更能掌握每位詩人個別的殊相。
description.describe_eh: Poetry works employ highly condensed language in accordance with certain metrical rules and forms to express the author's spiritual and soul feelings. Every poem that touches people's hearts and has been passed down for thousands of years is generally author's expression of his emotions and attitudes, and consequently enable readers to feel them through the works.  Among numerous reasons that affect the creation of poets, in addition to the environment of the times, the most important one is the personality of the poet himself and his life encounters. This course aims to guide students to appreciate poems thoroughly through careful observation of the experiences of poets in the Tang Dynasty. Don't just focus on the “universal” of the environment of the times, but also allow students to grasp the “particular” of each poet through this course.

targets.describe_ch: 透過細緻觀察唐代詩人經歷，瞭解其詩作特色及詩人生活特性。
targets.describe_en: To understand the characteristics of Tang Dynasty poems and poets' life characteristics through carefully observing the experiences of Tang Dynasty poets.

targets.describe_ch: 從詩人與其詩作，瞭解唐代時代精神和文化變遷軌跡。
targets.describe_en: To understand the spirit of the Tang Dynasty and the trajectory of cultural changes through poets and their poems.
